title: Pay betting operations tax
what: Pay betting operations tax on net State wagering revenue of $150,000 or more a financial year.

sources.title: Authorised Betting Operations Act 2000 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A betting operator is liable to pay tax (betting operations tax) to the Commissioner of State Taxation on the operator's net State wagering revenue for a financial year

sources.quote: if the net State wagering revenue for the financial year is less than $150 000—no tax is payable; (b) if the net State wagering revenue for the financial year is $150 000 or more—tax is payable at the rate of 15% of the amount of net State wagering revenue in excess of $150 000
